mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are waking up to overcast skies and a mild 65 degrees, which feels like 64, right over Verona Area High School.

In city sustainability news, Verona is making it easier for apartment residents to compost by highlighting the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is continuing its transportation green efforts, utilizing anti-idling tech on its new ambulance and promoting its status as a Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community.

We have a fun lineup of events this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness on July 20th. On Tuesday, July 21st, you can catch trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Louie. And do not miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July 22nd, at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way, where a teenager was cited for failing to yield the right-of-way, resulting in minor injuries to a 74-year-old driver.

If you are craving a sweet treat today, Culver's is serving up Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed but opens at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
